title: `atrium context --project .` never reached the resident service
notes: CLI sent the relative path as given; the service resolved it against its own directory,
found no repository and failed, so the CLI fell back to a cold in-process scan on every
call (14 s, curated pass up to 12 s) instead of the served answer (79 ms). The prompt mod
passed an absolute path and was unaffected; agents following the guidance were not.
result: `run_context_cli` resolves the project before the request (0a9be42); context responses now carry `served_by`, `elapsed_ms` and per-step `ms` (29e6928). Release advanced with `atrium-release` and the service restarted with `launchctl kickstart`.
evidence: `tests/test_context_cli_project.py`; full suite 584 passed; live `atrium context ... --project .` reports `served_by: service`, 61-66 ms warm.
